# TENSIX — Autonomous AI Systems, Cloud Infrastructure & High-Concurrency Software

> TENSIX (https://tensix.in/) is an enterprise autonomous AI systems, cloud infrastructure, and full-stack software engineering studio headquartered in Navrangpura, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India (23.0366° N, 72.5615° E). Founded and solely owned by Hemal Shah.
